en: The Wooloo bleated and wouldn't budge. {player} gave it a gentle nudge...
It trotted off through the gate and into its pen!
This Wooloo was fast asleep in the gateway. {player} gave it a gentle nudge...
It rolled off into its pen without waking up!
The last Wooloo stood its ground. {player} gave it a gentle nudge...
It bounced away into the last pen. The mission is cleared!
